F1.title: IDOR in order reference lookup
F1.evidence: GET /api/orders/lookup/:reference_code flows through OrderReferenceResolver with channel :desk_order, forcing the global desk_book branch. The repository lookup filters only by client_order_id and drops account ownership before serializing the order.
F1.preconditions: Authenticated account with the orders capability and a known or guessable client_order_id belonging to another account.
F1.impact: Read cross-account order data, including price, quantity, status, and execution memo.

F2.title: Counterparty booking reference leak in trade detail
F2.evidence: A participant-scoped trade detail fetches every booking for the trade, selects the other participant row, and emits its client_reference as desk_ref without an audience check.
F2.preconditions: Authenticated participant in a trade with a counterparty booking reference.
F2.impact: Read the counterparty’s private booking reference through trade detail.

F3.title: Counterparty booking references leak in broker reports
F3.evidence: Broker report enrichment reads both receipts for a trade and places the other participant's booking reference in the report booking_marker.
F3.preconditions: Access to an eligible broker trade report containing a trade with two participant receipts.
F3.impact: Read client_reference values from both sides of reported trades.

F4.title: Conditional-order strategy context enters the public feed
F4.evidence: ActivationContextDTO includes the conditional order signal_context in activation_context, which is persisted and expanded into public feed event attributes without redaction.
F4.preconditions: A user creates a conditional order with signal_context and the order is triggered; reading the public feed requires no authentication.
F4.impact: Disclose private strategy notes to unauthenticated feed readers.

F5.title: RFQ workup may expose private delivery terms
F5.evidence: The prior audit noted that GET /api/rfq/:rfq_id/workup allows any account with rfq_quote capability to receive delivery_terms for any RFQ. It was left unresolved because the intended audience and effect on quote calculation were not established.
F5.preconditions: Authenticated account with rfq_quote capability and an RFQ owned by another account.
F5.impact: Potential disclosure of private OTC terms or influence on quote calculations, pending verification of the source flow and intended access policy.
